description: Patients who have had a negative urine protein result on some lab test and a negative rheumatoid factor result on some lab test, not necessarily the same one.

a.request: For patients who have a laboratory record with `U-PRO` of '-' and a laboratory record (possibly a different one) with `RA` of '-', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `ALP` and average `HCT` across all of their lab records (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by average `HCT` from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
a.sql: SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-') AND l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL), AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: For patients who have tested '-' for both urine protein (`U-PRO`) and rheumatoid factor (`RA`), list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `ALP` and average `HCT` across all of their lab records (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by average `HCT` from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
